about_the_game:
Carceri is a living landscape; a chill, first-person narrative/exploration experience.

You'll visit gorgeous, interconnected zones while platforming, talking to cute NPCs, finding secrets, and taking pictures with a heavily upgradable camera, one that can distort the world beyond your wildest imagination!

You'll also follow a fun story, one about the Programs that run our world. They need your help, human, because in Carceri, you aren't a Character, you are YOU, the person at your PC, reading these words. This is their Reality, and you're just visiting.

-

Carceri is a 2-4 hour game made by a single human, a spiritual successor to ULTRAWORLD EXODUS. This is no Dark Souls, as anyone can complete the narrative portion, and there's plenty to experience afterwards (like an in-game philosophy podcast).

Works on Steamdeck, and, buying the game gives you the 41 song original soundtrack!

-

Carceri is quietly unlike anything you've played before. It's hard to explain (and sell), but it's absolutely worth the world's most precious resource: your time.
